Class NetworkLayer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.NetworkLayer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Observer
public class NetworkLayer extends Object implements Observer
The central network management layer responsible for mapping and coordinating connected clients. It provides thread-safe access to associations between users (nicknames), active games (game IDs), their active connections (VirtualClient), dedicated server threads, and message queues (EventBuffer).
